variants.text: A market cross, four streets, and more wheelwrights than a town this size can possibly need.
Cobbleway. Everything going to or from Sarnport stops here, and the town has arranged itself entirely around that.
Carts nose to tail in the market place, and the smell of hot iron from the tyring yard.
Stone-built and slate-roofed, and prosperous in an unshowy way.
